threepl.procs

Class EmptyValueProc

  • java.lang.Object
    • threepl.procs.InbuiltProc
      • threepl.procs.EmptyValueProc
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    TDEConstants, Constant

    public class EmptyValueProc
extends InbuiltProc
implements Constant, TDEConstants
    An inbuilt procedure to change a value variable to type "empty". There may be any number of arguments but each must be a value variable.

    • Method Detail

      • execute

        public void execute(NodeList inargs,
                    NodeList outargs,
                    TDEVar esig,
                    java.util.ArrayList<TDEVar> startl,
                    java.util.ArrayList<TDEVar> finishl,
                    QueueRefs queues,
                    boolean availok)
        Execute the procedure rmemoryread(). This does not generate in_line executable code.
        Parameters:
        inargs - is a list of input argument tree nodes
        outargs - is a list of output argument tree nodes
        esig - is an exception/restart signal, or null
        startl - is a list of start signals for target statements below this node
        finishl - is a list of finish signals for target statements below this node
        queues - returns all the queue availability signals accumulated from code below
        availok - is true if a previous sync makes a queue availability wait unnecessary
